Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
package sortalgorithms;

public class PatternsViaRecursion {
    public static void main(String[] args) {

        printPatternIter(5);
        printPatternRec(5 , 0);
    }

    private static void printPatternIter(int n) {
        for (int row = n; row > 0; row--) {
            for (int col = 0; col < row; col++) {
                System.out.print("*");
            }
            System.out.println();
        }
    }

    private static void printPatternRec(int row, int col) {
        if(row == 0) return;
        if(col < row){
            System.out.print("*");
            printPatternRec(row, col + 1);
        } else{
            System.out.println();
            printPatternRec(row - 1, 0);
        }


    }





}
